name: Secrets From a Songbird Poetry Book
description: Secrets From A Songbird is a poignant collection of original poetry by Meghan, written during her late teens and early twenties, that has never before been shared. Through her vivid imagery and genuine emotions, Meghan skillfully paints powerful pictures with words, taking readers on an introspective journey. Despite struggling with addiction, unresolved trauma, depression, and anxiety, Meghan finds beauty and joy through writing. She addresses the sentiment of unworthiness and a deep and threatening loneliness. This collection of poems uncovers Meghan’s deepest thoughts and feelings with whispers of wilderness, inviting readers to explore and feel the raw beauty of her words. Overall, Secrets From A Songbird is a must-read for poetry lovers seeking to connect with raw and authentic emotions.
